questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 65x^2 + 456 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 57)(x^2 - 8) = 0$ with $57 \neq 8 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{57}, \pm\sqrt{8}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Three-Dimensional Geometry (Direction Cosines & Projection).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 59x + 58 = 0$ and $x^2 - 3x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (3) + k = 0 \implies k = 2$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Three-Dimensional Geometry (Shortest Distance Between Skew Lines).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 118x + 6 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{118} = \frac{q}{6} \implies p = 59,\; q = 3 \implies p + q = 62$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Three-Dimensional Geometry (Foot of Perpendicular on Plane/Line).

questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 4$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 8x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 4$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(4) < 0 \implies 4^2 - 2(4^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 16$, so largest integer is $15$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Three-Dimensional Geometry (Coplanarity of Lines).
